edict.enactingAuthority: United States Congress
edict.instrumentTitle: D.C. Code § 1-204.04 Powers of the Council

regions.beginsWith: An act passed by the Council shall be presented by the Chairman of the Council to the Mayor,
regions.endsWith: two-thirds of the members of the Council present and voting vote to reenact such act, the act so reenacted shall become law subject to the provisions of § 1-206.02(c) .

edict.enactingAuthority: United States Congress
edict.instrumentTitle: D.C. Code § 1-204.12 Acts, resolutions, and requirements for quorum

regions.beginsWith: The Council, to discharge the powers and duties imposed herein,
regions.endsWith: such act shall be effective for a period of not to exceed 90 days.

regions.beginsWith: A majority of the Council shall constitute a quorum
regions.endsWith: except a lesser number may hold hearings.

edict.enactingAuthority: United States Congress
edict.instrumentTitle: D.C. Code § 1-206.02 Limitations on the Council

regions.beginsWith: the Chairman of the Council shall transmit to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, and the President of the Senate, a copy of each act passed by the Council
regions.endsWith: unless during such 30-day period, there has been enacted into law a joint resolution disapproving such act.

regions.beginsWith: In the case of any such act transmitted by the Chairman with respect to any act codified in Title 22, 23, or 24 of the District of Columbia Code
regions.endsWith: unless, during such 60-day period, there has been enacted into law a joint resolution disapproving such act.
